final: WITH per_film AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration AS fee_per_day FROM film), per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(fee_per_day) AS avg_fee, COUNT(fee_per_day) AS films FROM per_film GROUP BY rating), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fee) AS overall_avg FROM per_rating WHERE avg_fee IS NOT NULL) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_fee, r.films, r.avg_fee / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM per_rating r CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE r.avg_fee IS NOT NULL AND o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
